newsitem.title: CHINA: Yaohua Pilkington issues cash dividend.
newsitem.headline: Yaohua Pilkington issues cash dividend.

text.p: Shareholders of Shanghai Yaohua Pilkington Glass Co have approved the company's plan to issue a 0.15 yuan cash dividend per share, a company statement said on Tuesday.
Foreign currency B shareholders will get a $0.01809 cash dividend per share based on an exchange rate of 8.2921 yuan to the dollar, it said.
The ex-dividend date for both A and B shares will be July 15, it added.
Trading in the company's A and B shares was suspended on Tuesday morning and will resume in the afternoon, the statement said.
Yaohua reported a net profit of 80.39 million yuan in 1996 based on international accounting standards, compared with 189.763 million yuan booked in 1995.
